reviews.comment:
Se me rompio la moto (los amortiguadores) fui al lugar donde decia mecánica y les pregunte y me dijieron que  no hacian mecánica de moto pero me preguntaron que fue lo que paso y me ayudaron, hizo lo posible para conseguir los amortiguadores para mi moto, dejo de hacer las cosas que estaba haciendo para darme una mano, no me quizo cobrar nada, la verdad muy buena persona, hay muy poca gente asi como el que te ayuda sin esperar nada a cambio y lo hace de corazón,  me volvi ese mismo dia para capital un viaje de 6hs  con la moto gracias a racha y a su compañero.

(Translated by Google)
My motorcycle broke down (the shock absorbers). I went to a place that said "mechanics" and asked them. They told me they didn't do motorcycle repairs, but they asked me what happened and helped me. He did everything he could to get the shock absorbers for my motorcycle, he stopped what he was doing to help me, and he didn't want to charge me anything. He's a really good person; there are very few people like him who help you without expecting anything in return and does it from the heart. I returned to the capital that same day, a 6-hour trip on the motorcycle, thanks to Racha and his partner.
